description:
## [1.2.0](https://github.com/myvoow/LiquidMusic/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-11-02)

### ✨ New Features

* liquid tab bar, live settings, sidebar glass, accent color and icon ([4dad260](https://github.com/myvoow/LiquidMusic/commit/4dad2606cba1ae58e7fa5cd21f6f3b0a274af486))

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Replaces the red of Apple Music (buttons, links, the selected tab, progress) with another color. Blue matches the liquid tab bar.

options.description: Accent color when Apple Music is dark, as #RRGGBB. Apple's is #FA2D48.
Accent color when Apple Music is light, as #RRGGBB. Apple's is #FA233B.

patches.name: Liquid Glass
patches.description: Liquid Glass on the floating tab bar and the mini player: clear glass with refracted edges, vibrancy and a specular rim, and the liquid tab bar of Backdrop by Kyant, with a drop of glass on the active tab. Refraction requires Android 13, the rest Android 12.

options.description: Blur of the content behind the glass, in dp. Off keeps the glass clear, as Liquid Glass.
Width of the bent band along the edges of the glass, in dp. 0 disables the refraction.
How far the content is displaced at the very edge of the glass, in dp.
Saturation of the content behind the glass, in percent. 100 keeps the colors unchanged.
Opacity kept from the translucent material Apple Music draws over the tab bar and the mini player, in percent. Lower values show more of the glass.
Intensity of the light reflected on the rim of the glass, in percent.
Splits the colors of the refracted edges, like a prism (Android 13+).
Also applies the glass to the floating search bar and to the top bar on tablets.
Also applies the glass to the sidebar on tablets.
Draws the tab bar with LiquidBottomTabs, the liquid tab bar of Backdrop by Kyant: a drop of glass follows the active tab and can be dragged from tab to tab. Its glass has a light blur of its own.
Shows the names of the tabs under their icons in the liquid tab bar.
Removes the New tab from the liquid tab bar.
Removes the Radio tab from the liquid tab bar.
Tab the app opens on, with the liquid tab bar.
A light tick when the active tab changes, in the liquid tab bar.

patches.name: Liquid Glass icon
patches.description: Replaces the app icon with the LiquidMusic icon: a drop of glass over the colors. It also has a themed icon for Android 13+.
